tools.name: create_list
tools.description: Creates a trailer list on zinema.tv from movie and TV show titles. In apps that support interactive results, the trailers play in the conversation; the returned link opens the same list in a browser, with each trailer in the requested language when a dub exists. Use when the user asks for movie or s

tools.name: where_to_watch
tools.description: Used by the zinema trailer player: lists the streaming services that offer a title from a zinema list in a given country, with a link to each.

tools.name: get_list
tools.description: Check a zinema list you created earlier: which titles play now. A title that was 'pending' may have become 'playable' (its trailer gets acquired automatically) or 'no_trailer' (none exists anywhere).

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_list" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "create_list" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
